dct_description_sm: Contained within the 5th Edition (1978 to 1995) of the National Atlas of Canada is a map that shows membership of the Parliament resulting from 21 November 1988 election. A map of Canada (with 26 urban insets) shows the results of the election with Federal Electoral Districts coloured by the winning party. Matching table lists members elected and gives voting data. Charts summarize provincial and territorial results for 1984 and 1988 elections. Separate table lists members of the Senate as of mid-1990.
